# Covenant walkthrough

Work through the covenant position for {{ entity_name }}:

1. Pull the latest covenant certificate set.
2. Compare each declared covenant against its computed headroom.
3. Note any breach flag with the certificate it derives from.
4. Draft the review narrative from the reference checklist.
